Build: The aggregate that turns a column of strings into a single MARISA trie BLOB. Build once at ingest time, store the BLOB in any column type, query repeatedly. Updates require a rebuild — there is no incremental insert.
Query: Membership tests, autocomplete (predictive prefix), and longest-prefix-match against an existing trie BLOB. All three primitives run in O(|key|) — lookup work is independent of dictionary size.
